**Problem / use case**
What can't a JSON App do today that it should?

**Proposed solution**
A new widget? A builtin function? A DSL change? Sketch the JSON you'd want to write.

**Does it fit the capability boundary?**
The client only renders declarative JSON over a precompiled widget/builtin set
(see `JSON-DSL.md`). Note if this needs a new compiled capability vs. composing existing ones.
